name: listVersionExemptions
signature: @Remote listVersionExemptions(): { exemptions: Record<string, string[]>; warnings: string[] }
summary: Read exact plugin-version exemptions saved in this profile.

name: setVersionExemption
signature: @Remote setVersionExemption(packageVersion: string, runtimeVersion: string, enabled: boolean, acceptRisk?: boolean): Promise<ChangeResult>
summary: Grant or revoke one exact plugin/runtime exemption and reevaluate live plugins.

name: listPlugins
summary: Read current plugins, including why a row cannot be changed through the profile patch.

name: listBundles
summary: Read the profile's installed bundles, the bundles this dsh installation supplies, and the selected names that are not bundles.

name: registries
summary: Read the registries this manager asks: the configured first one, its fallbacks in order, and what pnpm's own configuration names.

name: inspect
signature: @Remote async inspect(spec: string, options?: InspectOptions, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise<PluginSpecInspection>
summary: Read what a spec names before installing it.

name: setPluginEnabled
summary: Persist a plugin entry's desired enablement and apply it on live profiles.

name: setBundleEnabled
summary: Select or remove a bundle layer while retaining installed dependencies.

name: installBundle
summary: Install a package using the same pnpm implementation as dsh plugin.

name: waitForInstall
summary: Recover the result of an active installation without cancelling it.

name: cancelInstall
summary: Stop an installation this manager owns and wait until its files are back.

name: removeBundle
summary: Unload and remove a profile-owned bundle dependency through dsh plugin's pnpm path.
